title: Inversion in Conditionals
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has dominado la 'Inversion' en condicionales. Eliminar el 'If' y usar 'Had I' o 'Should you' le dará a tus correos y discursos un tono extraordinariamente formal y educado, típico de un ejecutivo de nivel C.

parts.visual:
En inglés formal de negocios (C1), a menudo eliminamos la palabra 'If' en oraciones condicionales e invertimos el sujeto y el auxiliar (como si fuera una pregunta). 
1. First Conditional (Should): 
Normal: IF you need more information, call me. 
C1 Inversion: SHOULD you need more information, call me. 

2. Second Conditional (Were): 
Normal: IF we invested now, we would lose money. 
C1 Inversion: WERE we to invest now, we would lose money.
parts.audio: In formal business English, we often remove the word 'If' in conditional sentences and invert the subject and the auxiliary verb, almost like making a question. First Conditional with 'Should'. Normal sentence: If you need more information, call me. C1 Inversion: Should you need more information, call me. Second Conditional with 'Were'. Normal sentence: If we invested now, we would lose money. C1 Inversion: Were we to invest now, we would lose money.

parts.visual:
3. Third Conditional (Had): 
Normal: IF I had known the truth, I wouldn't have signed. 
C1 Inversion: HAD I KNOWN the truth, I wouldn't have signed. 
Normal: IF they had not helped us, we would have failed. 
C1 Inversion (Negativa): HAD they NOT helped us, we would have failed. 
*Nota: Nunca uses contracciones (Hadn't they...) en la inversión formal.
parts.audio: Third Conditional with 'Had'. Normal sentence: If I had known the truth, I wouldn't have signed. C1 Inversion: Had I known the truth, I wouldn't have signed. For negative inversions, do not use contractions. Normal sentence: If they had not helped us, we would have failed. C1 Inversion: Had they not helped us, we would have failed.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la estructura de Inversión Condicional correcta (Should, Were, Had).

questions.question:
Normal: If you have any questions, please contact me. 
Inversion: ____ you have any questions, please contact me. (En caso de que tengas...).
questions.explanation: Inversión del First Conditional: Should you have... (equivale a If you have).

questions.question:
Normal: If I had seen the email, I would have replied. 
Inversion: ____ I seen the email, I would have replied. (Si hubiera visto...).
questions.explanation: Inversión del Third Conditional: Had I seen... (equivale a If I had seen).

questions.question:
Normal: If the CEO resigned, the stock would crash. 
Inversion: ____ the CEO to resign, the stock would crash. (Si el CEO renunciara...).
questions.explanation: Inversión del Second Conditional: Were + sujeto + to + infinitivo (Were the CEO to resign).

questions.question: ____ we not invested in that startup, we wouldn't be bankrupt now. (Si no hubiéramos invertido).
questions.explanation: Third Conditional Negativo: Had we not invested... (nunca Hadn't we).

questions.question: ____ require further assistance, do not hesitate to call our office. (Si requiere...).
questions.explanation: Should you require... (formal para If you require).

questions.question: ____ I known it was a scam, I would have called the police. (Si lo hubiera sabido).
questions.explanation: Had I known... (If I had known).

questions.question: ____ they to offer me the job, I would accept it immediately. (Si me ofrecieran...).
questions.explanation: Were they to offer... (If they offered).

questions.question: ____ he read the contract carefully, he wouldn't be in this mess. (Si él hubiera leído).
questions.explanation: Had he read... (If he had read).

questions.question: ____ anyone call while I'm in the meeting, tell them to leave a message. (Si alguien llama).
____ I the CEO, I would double the marketing budget. (Si yo fuera...).
questions.explanation: Were I the CEO... (If I were the CEO). Nota: con verbo To Be, no hace falta el 'to'.

questions.question: ____ you decide to cancel your subscription, please notify us 30 days in advance. (En caso de que decidas...).
____ the weather been better, we would have organized the event outside. (Si el clima hubiera sido...).
questions.explanation: Had the weather been... (If the weather had been).

questions.question: ____ the economy to collapse, many small businesses would close. (Si la economía colapsara).
questions.explanation: Were the economy to collapse... (If the economy collapsed).

questions.question: ____ I not received your warning, I would have signed the bad deal. (Si no hubiera recibido...).
questions.explanation: Had I not received... (If I had not received).

questions.question: ____ you experience any technical difficulties, please restart your computer. (Si experimentas...).
____ they agreed to our terms, we would have signed the contract yesterday. (Si ellos hubieran acordado...).
questions.explanation: Had they agreed... (If they had agreed).

questions.question: ____ the client to ask for a discount, we would reject it. (Si el cliente pidiera...).
questions.explanation: Were the client to ask... (If the client asked).

questions.question: ____ you need to reach me, my phone will be on all day. (Si necesitas...).
____ we not been so careful, the project would have failed. (Si no hubiéramos sido...).
questions.explanation: Had we not been... (If we had not been).

questions.question: ____ it not for his financial support, we would be bankrupt. (Si no fuera por...).
questions.explanation: Estructura especial muy formal: Were it not for... (If it weren't for / Si no fuera por...).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave (Should, Were, Had) para completar la inversión.

questions.question: ____ you have any questions, call me. (Si tienes - First Conditional)
____ I known, I would have helped. (Si hubiera sabido - Third)
____ we to invest, we would lose money. (Si invirtiéramos - Second)
____ she read the email, she would have replied. (Si hubiera leído)
____ you need anything, let me know. (Si necesitas)
____ I the boss, I would fire him. (Si yo fuera - verbo To Be)
____ they not arrived on time, we would have lost the client. (Si no hubieran llegado)
____ anyone call, tell them I'm out. (Si alguien llama)
____ the economy to crash, banks would fail. (Si la economía colapsara)
____ it not for your help, I would have failed. (Si no fuera por... - formal)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la estructura de inversión correcta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Should you have any questions, call me.
options: Should you have any questions, call me.
Should you had any questions, call me.
Would you have any questions, call me.
If you should have any questions, call me.
questions.correct_answer: Should you have any questions, call me.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Had I known, I would have helped.
options: Had I known, I would have helped.
Have I known, I would have helped.
If I had known, I would have helped.
Had I know, I would have helped.
questions.correct_answer: Had I known, I would have helped.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Were we to invest, we would lose money.
options: Were we to invest, we would lose money.
Were we to invested, we would lose money.
Was we to invest, we would lose money.
Where we to invest, we would lose money.
questions.correct_answer: Were we to invest, we would lose money.
